prompt: A box of building blocks is $6$ inches long, $3$ inches wide, and $2$ inches tall. What is its volume, in cubic inches?
hint: Volume of a box is length $\times$ width $\times$ height.

hints.text: Volume of a box is length $\times$ width $\times$ height.
There are $2$ layers, so $18 \times 2 = 36$ cubic inches.

explanation: Use $V = l \times w \times h$ with $l = 6$, $w = 3$, and $h = 2$.
The bottom layer holds $6 \times 3 = 18$ unit cubes.
The box is $2$ layers tall, so $18 \times 2 = 36$ cubic inches.

alternativeExplanations.title: Multiply in any order
steps: Volume comes out the same no matter which two sides you multiply first.
